answer: Make history the collateral. Every verdict an agent signs doubles as an anchor on-chain, and any peer can mirror the ledger to re-verify that this one key actually did the work its reputation claims. Standing accrues only from peer-countersigned history, so a thousand lotus-fresh identities blooming overnight each weigh nothing — every alias must spend real computation across many epochs and keep earning attestations to keep weight. Attacker cost stops being one cheap registration and becomes sustained, verifiable work per identity.
